name: GNSS Live Tracker V2 (ESP-IDF v5.4)
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -f /opt/esp/idf/export.sh ]; then . /opt/esp/idf/export.sh; elif [ -n "${IDF_PATH:-}" ] && [ -f "$IDF_PATH/export.sh" ]; then . "$IDF_PATH/export.sh"; else echo "ERROR: ESP-IDF export.sh not found in /opt/esp/idf or IDF_PATH/export.sh"; exit 1; fi; idf.py --version'
